title: Calgary: 10-Day Western Canada Tour to Vancouver
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning landscapes of Banff National Park over three unforgettable days. Begin your journey with a scenic drive from Calgary, enjoying iconic sights like the Banff Gondola and Bow Falls. The second day immerses you in the breathtaking beauty of Lake Louise and Moraine Lake, with opportunities for light hikes and canoeing. Conclude your adventure with a visit to Johnston Canyon before returning to Calgary. With expert guides and comfortable accommodations included, this tour is perfect for nature enthusiasts and adventure seekers alike.

- 3-day tour featuring Banff, Lake Louise, and Yoho National Park
- Includes 2-night stay in a 3-star hotel and daily breakfast
- Private round-trip transport from Calgary Airport with entry tickets
- Guided visits to stunning natural landmarks and optional activities available
